reports.description: I was invited by Eric Cullins on Linkedin who encouraged me to start trading. He told me that the company he is currently working for will give me a huge profit and I can invest with as little as $300. He opens an account for me on www.cryptoglobeline.com and asked me to log in there every day to see how quickly the money is growing up/ rising up. 2 weeks later, I wrote an e-mail to the head office that I would like to withdrawal all the money out of the trading account. Since that moment continuously I was receiving lots of different e-mails saying that there was another fee I had to pay. It was so suspicious to me as every e-mail I received from them had exactly the same story/Context such as ‚Äûas soon as you pay that fee we will transfer the money to you immediately/ in 24 hours/12hours/ few hours/ etc.‚Äô‚Äô. I noticed that after about a month later the guy who invited me on Linkedin removed his account. He only contacted me via WhatsApp when there was another fee to pay. I was so frustrated about the whole situation and so anxious. I decided to write an e-mail to the head office ‚Äì ‚ÄûPlease confirm that this is the last fee to pay and there is no more‚Äù. The answer was so clear from them ‚Äûthere are no more fees to pay, and that is the last one‚Äù. I paid that fee and Of course, they were lying! At the very end, as the last e-mail, I received from them was ‚Äûyour account is on dormant/ is deactivated. If you want us to re-active that account you have to pay another fee‚Äô‚Äô. I replied to them saying the last e-mail from you it is a clear evidence that you are currently working on transferring the money to my bank account, and there are no more other fees to pay. They warn me that If I don‚Äôt pay that fee Eric Cullins and me we will be in big trouble. From that moment I stopped talking to them.
